purpose: decision-affecting validation artifacts pinned by the cohort policy digest; a changed file is a policy change and needs the owner's approval of the new digest
evidence_file: docs/validation/eggy_evidence.json is controlled by operational/evidence_refresh.py (identity pinned, hash-chained history, automatic roll-forward of routine refreshes)

player_signals.decides: how much a role / opportunity flag is worth beyond the model (a measured downward probability adjustment, or demoted to LOW and not counted) and that the shots estimate is the validated model probability
player_signals.data: MoneyPuck skater rows 2022-23 to 2026-10-20 (52,907 rows walked), time-ordered

points_thresholds.decides: which Player Points thresholds may be live legs and the recalibration of points>=2

dependence_lift.decides: the measured pairwise dependence of legs of one game, used in ticket probability and in the portfolio simulation
dependence_lift.data: same-game pairs 2025-26 and 2026-27 to date, relative to a cross-game control

price_freshness.decides: whether a leg's sportsbook price is FRESH, AGING (admitted with a visible note) or STALE (not admitted to a parlay), per market
